item.text:
The targeted search recovered several usable primary records:

- IAEA’s 2020 Safeguards Statement places Türkiye in the 72 states for which it found no indication of diversion or undeclared nuclear material/activities (PDF p. 5, lines 189–203; Turkey named at lines 192–200), and lists Turkey’s INFCIRC/295 safeguards agreement (p. 17, line 689). This is state-level contrary evidence, not a personal Erdoğan act.
- The Turkish Parliament’s official Law 7253 record gives the 29 July 2020 adoption, presidential transmission, “ONAY” approval, and 31 July publication (TBMM record lines 144–154), while the primary text requires a Turkish representative for large foreign social networks.
- World Bank records add target-period education delivery, poverty-transfer, employment, and pandemic-policy evidence: the June 25 project (lines 50–60), August 11 containment/support assessment (lines 50–59), and the Economic Monitor’s page-75 poverty simulations plus paragraphs 97–99.
- UN Women’s October 2020 Türkiye assessment explicitly covers employment, household resources, health/basic services, discrimination, and domestic violence (lines 48–80).

These will be recorded as distinct units with attribution and temporal caveats; I am not treating institutional or country-level findings as personal ruler evidence.

Direct continuation research completed. Recovered:

- IAEA 2020 safeguards conclusion for Türkiye: no indication of diversion or undeclared nuclear material/activities (PDF pp. 5, 17). [IAEA Safeguards Statement](https://www.iaea.org/sites/default/files/21/06/statement-sir-2020.pdf)
- Primary TBMM record for Law 7253: adopted 29 July, presidentially approved, published 31 July 2020. [TBMM record](https://www.tbmm.gov.tr/Yasama/Kanun/f72877c1-76d7-037b-e050-007f01005610)
- World Bank 2020 evidence on distance education, containment, transfers, poverty, employment, and unequal recovery. [Education project](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2020/06/25/responding-to-covid-19-and-looking-beyond-turkey-invests-in-safer-schooling-and-distance-education-with-the-world-bank-support), [Economic Monitor](https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/300771597079660362/pdf/Turkey-Economic-Monitor-Adjusting-the-Sails.pdf)
- UN Women’s October 2020 assessment covering employment, services, discrimination, and domestic violence. [Assessment](https://wrd.unwomen.org/practice/resources/economic-and-social-impact-covid-19-women-and-men-rapid-gender-assessment-covid)

I prepared additions EV-109, EV-110, EV-409, and EV-611–EV-615, including locators, period fit, attribution limits, contrary evidence, and lens mappings. EV-401 should be downgraded to corroborative context because EV-409 is the primary enactment record.
